findings: [P2] packages/cadenda/backup.py:create — The primary HEAD is recorded in git_heads but never added to the bundle's required commits. When the repository has a detached HEAD that no ref or historical run references, `bundle create --all ...` can omit that commit (or fail for an otherwise empty bundle). Explicitly include and validate HEAD; test backup/restore of an unreferenced detached primary HEAD.

[P2] packages/cadenda/staging.py:prepare; packages/cadenda/server.py:stage_apply — Staging uses the server's startup Registry throughout. Unlike Pipeline.review, it never reloads the configuration file. Changing configured checks, documents, decisions, or staging_enabled after server startup therefore leaves staging comparing requirement hashes against stale configuration and can permit publication after the owner revokes staging. Reload and validate current configuration for preview, confirmation, and the final publication check; reject changed plans.
